## GPT-6.2 Astra API

GPT-6.2 Astra is a large language model by OpenAI, available on the Venice API as `openai-gpt-62-astra`. The provider of this model may retain prompt data (though it is anonymized by Venice). For sensitive content, use a private model.

GPT-6.2 Astra is the flagship model in OpenAI's GPT-6.2 series, built for the hardest projects. It is suited for real-world engineering, professional work, and scientific research, with stronger visual reasoning for websites, slideshows, and 3D designs. It has a 1.05M token context window (922K input, 128K output) and support for text and image inputs.

### GPT-6.2 Astra API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `openai-gpt-62-astra` | Standard | Anonymized | $8.00 / $40.00 per 1M |

### How to use the GPT-6.2 Astra API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/responses` with `"model": "openai-gpt-62-astra"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "openai-gpt-62-astra",
    "input": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences.",
    "reasoning": { "effort": "high" }
  }'
```
